observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon-branded cardboard box labeled 'D750' next to a smaller box labeled 'Nikkor Lens 50' and a larger box printed with an image of a gimbal/stabilizer rig holding a camera, plus a torn/taped shipping label.
Photo 1 shows the same D750 box open, containing only printed manuals ('D750 User's Manual', an apparel/accessory manual) and barcode stickers, no visible camera body.
Photo 2 shows a box interior with items fully wrapped in bubble wrap; shapes are indistinct, no visible lens glass, mount, buttons, or screen.
No photo shows the actual camera body out of wrapping, no serial number plate, no lens mount, no power-on/LCD screen, no shutter count display.
Box shows shipping tape, tears, and a used/resealed look consistent with a repackaged or reused box.

claims.evidence: Only the outer box and manuals are shown in photos 0-2; the camera body itself is never visible, so origin and even presence of the body cannot be confirmed.
No photo of the body's exterior, LCD, or lens mount to assess cosmetic condition.
No power-on shot, no shutter count screen, no sample image; only bubble-wrapped bulges are shown in photo 2.

risks.risk: Box may not actually contain a Nikon D750 body (empty box or wrong item swapped in).
risks.proof: A photo of the unwrapped body showing the Nikon D750 nameplate, lens mount, and serial number sticker.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified identity/contents, worst case treated as unconfirmed body

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or may have shutter/sensor faults (common in grey-market 'American used' imports).
risks.proof: A clip or photo of the camera powered on, showing live view/LCD menu and shutter count screen.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be very high despite cosmetic claims of 'as new'.
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count from a diagnostic app or menu screen.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-use/worst case shutter life

risks.risk: Lens (Nikkor 50mm) and gimbal/stabilizer box shown may or may not be included in this sale, creating confusion on what is actually being sold.
risks.proof: A single photo with all included items laid out together with the camera body visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body-only, unconfirmed accessories excluded

proof_requests: Unbox and photograph the actual camera body fully out of wrapping, showing the Nikon D750 badge and lens mount.
Photo of the serial number plate on the body base.
Power the camera on and photograph the LCD screen showing menu or shutter count.
A short video of the shutter firing and lens autofocus (if a lens is included) in operation.
response.reason: All three photos show only boxes, manuals, and bubble-wrapped bulges; the camera body itself, its serial number, and any sign of power-on are never shown, so neither identity-in-hand nor a worst-case working/non-working price can be anchored without a photo of the actual unwrapped body.
